ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Planet Google Analyzes Google as an example of a defining new media company and as a lens through which to reflect critically on the ways in which new media companies and their products change our communication experiences and our understanding of the world. Outcomes of the course include learning (1) how to do business research about new media companies and (2) how to critically assess Google and other New Media companies. If seats are available: Course may open to campus at 8:30 am on April 15th.
